result.summary: Several layout and clipping issues: category chips and restaurant cards overflow the screen, restaurant names are truncated, and the last popular card is cut off by the tab bar.

issues.description: The last restaurant card in “Fastest near you” (Trattoria Piccol…) is clipped on the right, and the restaurant name is truncated.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent horizontal padding/insets, allow the carousel to scroll fully, and use wrapping or an ellipsis so names stay readable.

issues.description: The bottom “Popular right now” card is cut off by the tab bar, so the restaurant name, rating, and details are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/safe-area inset so list content clears the tab bar, or make the last card fully visible above it.

issues.description: The category filter chips overflow the right edge (“Healthy” is cut off) with no clear indication of more options.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the chip row scrolls horizontally with enough end padding, and keep the last visible chip fully on-screen or add a fade/peek affordance.

issues.description: The promo banner’s decorative circles are clipped by the rounded card corners, which looks unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Inset the decorative shapes so they sit fully inside the banner, or clip them more intentionally so they don’t look cropped.
